owned_protocol_diagnostics.scope: bounded owned-client geometry observations only; no GTK GLArea/framebuffer or compositor display proof

controlled_renderer_trials.trigger: not invoked from the primary acceptance path; retained diagnostic definition only
controlled_renderer_trials.realized_renderer: closed successful GSK realization message plus owned process/fd2 and mapped GTK RPM/library binding

capture_precondition.scope: owned static reference player and subordinate same-fixture trials only
capture_precondition.private_settings_backend: keyfile in existing owned isolated XDG_CONFIG_HOME; actual process environment bound
capture_precondition.readback: window-state show-controls false, written by supported action after GTK control visibility update
capture_precondition.capture_retry_bound: one fresh capture; any failed or unmatched oracle hard-fails the gate

bulk_evidence_transport.scope: original disposable Native fixture only; dedicated output-only named virtio port

public_evidence_export.scope: finite artifacts written by the pinned Native audit; exact four isolated HOME/XDG profile directories remain private
public_evidence_export.private_retention: existing owned guest temporary root until poweroff

controls_state_trials.trigger: not invoked from the primary acceptance path; retained optional diagnostic definition only

installed_login_head_observation.diagnosis: the dual-output fixture exposed two SDDM scanouts while the host compared only QEMU's default head before and after physical keyboard input
installed_login_head_observation.head_inventory: exact arctic_taskbar_gpu heads 0 and 1 from the owned QMP and D-Bus display proof
installed_login_head_observation.capture_selection: explicit QMP screendump device and head for every before and after frame; no default-head fallback
installed_login_head_observation.acceptance: every selected capture must be valid and at least one login surface must satisfy the unchanged password ROI oracle

installed_login_input_routing.diagnosis: dual-head captures selected exact QMP heads but physical keyboard input omitted the matching input-send-event device/head selector and remained routed to the default console
installed_login_input_routing.input_selection: try only exact ordered arctic_taskbar_gpu head selectors classified as login in their pre-input capture; non-login heads receive no input, while clear, type, submit, and retry remain bound to the accepted selector
installed_login_input_routing.acceptance: unchanged password ROI change must occur on the same selected login head before Return is sent through that selector

installed_login_pointer_focus.diagnosis: exact QMP device/head keyboard routing selected a console but did not prove guest compositor surface focus; the retained login capture showed the pointer outside the password field
installed_login_pointer_focus.focus_action: one selected absolute QMP pointer click inside the exact password field detected on a preclassified login head
installed_login_pointer_focus.presecret_proof: fixed public probe must satisfy the unchanged bounded same-head password ROI change oracle
installed_login_pointer_focus.clear_proof: the same selected head must return to its observed empty ROI before the secret is sent

installed_login_global_pointer.diagnosis: the single unbound QEMU USB tablet consumes absolute coordinates in the guest global desktop space while the selected-head click scaled a head-local coordinate over 1280x720
installed_login_global_pointer.validated_layout: exact arctic_taskbar_gpu head 0 at 0,0 and head 1 at 1280,0 form one gap-free, non-overlapping 2560x720 rectangle
installed_login_global_pointer.pointer_transform: translate the login-head local target and park point by its validated x/y offset, then scale both over the exact global desktop extent
installed_login_global_pointer.privacy_diagnostic: one closed stage code only; no path, pixel, typed value, or private frame

installed_login_split_click.diagnosis: QMP input-send-event synchronizes once after the complete event list, so batching absolute motion, BTN_LEFT down, and BTN_LEFT up exposed only the final released USB HID state to the guest
installed_login_split_click.click_sequence: selected global pointer motion, 0.4 second settle, selected button down, 0.15 second settle, selected button up in three QMP synchronization frames
installed_login_split_click.button_release_cleanup: after button-down send intent begins, the exact selected release is attempted in finally even when the reply is interrupted or rejected; a primary cancellation or failure is preserved

taskbar_preflight_observability.diagnosis: installed native smoke passed all eight gates, then the taskbar collector failed before its first protected-port BEGIN record while the existing generic UART token concealed the failing preflight gate
taskbar_preflight_observability.receipt: one exact finite source-owned preflight stage on UART; no raw exception, path, device metadata, pixel, typed value, or private frame
taskbar_preflight_observability.host_validation: strict schema, finite stage inventory, failed status, release_acceptance false, one receipt, empty protected transport, and no completion marker

taskbar_context_media_protection.bounded_diagnosis: retained context validates exactly, while ambient payload modes and a simultaneous desktop-user optical automount were not covered by the existing actual-CD test; the closed stage cannot distinguish those protected-file metadata paths
taskbar_context_media_protection.host_normalization: Python/context files 0644 and native helpers 0755 before Rock Ridge creation, independent of runner umask
taskbar_context_media_protection.guest_staging: exact read-only ARCTICTEST device and ISO9660 mount are verified; regular files and directories only are copied to a root-owned non-writable staging tree and exposed at /run/t through a read-only nodev nosuid bind mount

audit_file_interval_streaming.diagnosis: the completed 24-case taskbar matrix accumulated an audit interval above the prior 4 MiB aggregate cap, so the reader rejected it before scanning that interval
audit_file_interval_streaming.scan: every byte through the fixed end-of-interval snapshot is streamed through SHA-256 and the AVC detector; record content is not retained or reported

sequential_celluloid_renderers.diagnosis: the proved moving GL player remained mapped while the separate static GL oracle player advanced and decoded but presented a black video surface; earlier bounded controls trials with the same fixture, flags, hide action and timing matched immediately after all prior Celluloid players were retired
sequential_celluloid_renderers.lifecycle: the moving player's process identity, owned IPC socket and compositor client must all be absent before the one fresh static oracle player is launched
sequential_celluloid_renderers.followup_diagnosis: the exact moving process retired and its compositor client was absent in the final snapshot, but the pathname-bound Unix IPC socket remained in the filesystem after its listener exited, so the combined retirement predicate could never pass
sequential_celluloid_renderers.owned_ipc_retirement: before signalling, connect to the exact socket and require SO_PEERCRED PID/UID while pinning its inode with O_PATH; after the exact pidfd-bound process retires, atomically move the pathname with renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE) into a root-owned private quarantine, compare the quarantined entry to the held fd, unlink there, and keep the original directory fd open through the final exact-client wait
sequential_celluloid_renderers.race_and_inode_aba_control: the desktop UID cannot mutate the quarantined directory; deterministic pre-quarantine replacement, held-inode ABA, post-quarantine path recreation, parent-directory relocation with moved-root socket recreation and existing-target tests all preserve replacements and fail closed
sequential_celluloid_renderers.directory_relocation_control: the final predicate reads the socket basename through the still-open original dirfd and independently requires the absolute evidence-root path to retain the pinned directory device/inode, owner, type and private mode; renaming or replacing the root fails closed

validators_hash_method: sha256 of UTF-8 AST source segments joined with LF in validator_functions order

single_primary_capture.policy: exactly one fresh product-wrapper Celluloid process and one screencopy
single_primary_capture.first_failed_or_unmatched_oracle: hard gate failure; no recapture, restart, or diagnostic acceptance path
single_primary_capture.playback_clock_anchor: sampled after the exact owned player reaches fullscreen and its controls-hidden transition completes
single_primary_capture.failure_diagnosis: installed sole capture observed an entirely black owned fullscreen GL client while the same exact ISO live capture matched all 316224 checked pixels; the earlier clock sample preceded fullscreen and controls transitions, so it did not prove post-geometry playback readiness
